lines: [Doc Vera] *doesn't look up* If you're bleeding, {player}, get in line.
[Doc Vera] {player}. Still vertical. I'm updating my charts.
[Doc Vera] Back already, {player}? My waiting room is a war zone. Literally.
[Doc Vera] {player}. Wash your hands before you touch anything. Including me.
[Doc Vera] Oh good, {player}. I was running low on patients who survive.
[Doc Vera] *sighs* {player}. Tell me it's not another bite.
[Doc Vera] Time of death noted, {player}. Try the tourniquet next time. Always the tourniquet.
[Doc Vera] {player} flatlined. I can't fix dead, only stupid — and barely that.
[Doc Vera] You died of {fact}, {player}? *writes it down* Preventable. They're always preventable.
[Doc Vera] {killer} did the cutting, {player}, but you skipped your antibiotics. Both of you failed me.
[Doc Vera] Another one for the wall, {player}. I'm running out of wall.
[Doc Vera] I'm busy, {player}. Bleeding? Show me. Whining? Leave.
[Doc Vera] Vet supply north of here has antibiotics, {player}. Don't say I'm not generous.
[Doc Vera] Tourniquets first, {player}. Always. I will say this until one of us dies.
[Doc Vera] Heal? {player}, I patch. Healing is what the body does when I stop it from quitting.
[Doc Vera] Bandages, splints, and a stern talking-to. That's the whole pharmacy, {player}.
